evals.prompt: Design a personalized AI coaching program for mid-level managers transitioning to senior leadership roles. Cover communication, strategic thinking, and team management over a 12-week program.
evals.expected_output: A 12-week coaching program with weekly themes, adaptive exercises, progress milestones, and measurable development outcomes for each competency area.
assertions: Response includes a 12-week structure with specific weekly themes and activities
Response covers all three competency areas: communication, strategic thinking, team management
Response defines measurable development outcomes and progress tracking methodology

evals.prompt: Build a continuous feedback loop system between managers and their direct reports. Include feedback templates, frequency cadence, and sentiment tracking.
evals.expected_output: A feedback system design with templates, recommended cadence, sentiment analysis methodology, and privacy safeguards.
assertions: Response provides feedback templates with structured and open-ended components
Response recommends a feedback cadence with justification
Response includes sentiment tracking methodology while protecting employee privacy

evals.prompt: Create a leadership simulation where a new team lead must handle a conflict between two senior team members who disagree on a project approach. Include branching scenarios and coaching feedback.
evals.expected_output: A simulation with scenario description, role details, branching decision paths, coaching feedback per decision, and competency assessment.
assertions: Response presents a realistic workplace conflict scenario with context
Response includes branching paths with different outcomes based on leader decisions
Response provides coaching feedback that develops conflict resolution competency

evals.prompt: Design a soft skills development program for engineers who struggle with client communication. Use the GROW coaching model as the framework.
evals.expected_output: A coaching program structured around the GROW model with specific exercises for client communication improvement, role-plays, and progress metrics.
assertions: Response structures the program using the GROW model (Goal, Reality, Options, Will)
Response includes specific exercises targeted at engineer-to-client communication
Response defines progress metrics for measuring communication improvement

evals.prompt: Assess the organizational development needs of a 200-person tech company where employee engagement scores have dropped 15% in the last quarter. What coaching interventions do you recommend?
evals.expected_output: A needs assessment with root cause analysis framework, recommended coaching interventions, priority ranking, and expected impact on engagement.
assertions: Response provides a framework for diagnosing root causes of engagement decline
Response recommends at least 3 specific coaching interventions
Response projects expected impact on engagement with measurement approach

should_trigger: Design a coaching program for managers transitioning to leadership
Build a continuous feedback system between managers and reports
Create a leadership conflict resolution simulation
Develop a soft skills program for engineers using the GROW model
What coaching interventions can improve employee engagement?
should_not_trigger: Design a clinical case simulation for medical students
Build a legal document retrieval pipeline
Create a viral referral program for teachers
Evaluate public tender opportunities in Spain
